stem.text: A positively charged particle P is in an electric field, as shown.

stem.alt: Six parallel vertical field lines with arrows pointing up, with a dot labelled P between the middle lines.
Key with a horizontal arrow labelled X pointing left and a vertical double-headed arrow labelled Y at the top and Z at the bottom, meeting at a common point.

stem.text: The field lines (lines of force) are evenly spaced and parallel.

A.text: Moving P a small distance in any direction will not change the electric force on P.

B.text: Moving P a small distance in direction Y will increase the electric force on P.

C.text: Moving P a small distance in direction Z will increase the electric force on P.

D.text: Moving P a small distance in direction X will increase the electric force on P.
